tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Live sale and rental listings from 20 property portals, every listing in one schema (price, currency, beds, baths, area, address, coordinates, photos, agent). Costs 1 credit per listing returned; a failed portal read costs nothing. Portal keys by country: AE: bayut (rent/sale), propertyfinder (sale/

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: The portals search_listings can read: country, rent or sale, accepted filters and how to write the location. Free.

labels.name: get_listing
labels.description: The full record of one listing from its `url` (as returned by search_listings). Costs 1 credit; a failed read costs nothing. Works only for sources with details=true in list_sources: realtor, redfin-rentals, craigslist (Craigslist and Redfin rentals among them).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_listings" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
